name: Blueman
storyline:
Rumors say people vanish without a trace in this corporation’s offices. Newspapers report hundreds of disappearances—employees seem to dissolve after night shifts, and the last time they’re seen alive, they’re heading to the elevator after midnight. The police refuse to comment, saying “the investigation is ongoing.”

And still, the company’s vacancies never stay open for long. Bills must be paid, and office work always seems so simple… until you’re inside.

You start as an intern in a demonic corporation where each level is a unique floor, blending routine tasks with strange new instructions. Colleagues and management will keep you from doing your job properly, and any mistake may end in termination.
summary: Blueman is an office-worker simulator set in a demonic corporation. Each floor tests your attention to detail, and mistakes send you back to the start of the workday.
